analysis: The PR contains only documentation: a new changelog fragment (changelog.d/qwen-end-of-prompt-checkpoints.md, lines 1-13) and one added table row in docs/architecture/inference.md (head line 1406) for `demandedLatestCheckpointMinimumTokens`. No executable code is changed, so no controls are weakened in this diff. The Swift code behind the row (EngineV2Factory+DemandedCheckpoint.swift) and the prefix-cache.md anchor were not supplied. The documented behavior is that a dense Qwen 3.5/3.8 solo request now also ends a prefill range just below the prompt end, at least 64 tokens before it on the 256-token grid. That adds one more SSD checkpoint per long request, so it increases the number of encrypted SSD cache entries. Relevant threat: T-041, in particular the TTL, disk-budget, per-donation gating and HMAC lookup-tag policy. The changelog says the checkpoint is written only when it saves at least 1,024 tokens, which matches the existing benefit-floor gate. Remaining integration questions for the actual code change: (1) the new checkpoint must use the same cacheSalt scoping, HMAC lookup tags, 30-minute TTL, endurance and disk guards, and write-gating as existing checkpoints; (2) the scope-bound identity must not be loosened; (3) the checkpoint must be restorable bit-exactly. The doc states identical outputs but this was not verified here. The code change itself needs review. T-041 does not need updating for the docs alone.
